ns0:svg.ns0:title: Routing Driver Review
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Routing as implemented in the PULSE A0.9 instrument. The companion routing guide provides equivalent decision rules and question IDs.

ns0:rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(9%,41%,33%); fill-rule: evenodd;

ns0:g.ns0:text: 4. Optional driver comparison of both DCEs
This partner-review option adds a second service comparison. The ordinary single-technology route remains the default.
PULSE citizen survey | A0.9 instrument | 6 November 2026 | Routing logic is unchanged by the compact presentation.

ns0:rect.style: stroke: rgb(78%,85%,81%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(90%,95%,92%); fill-rule: evenodd;

ns0:g.ns0:text: Partner link: ?dce=both-drivers
The review flag is retained in the response and analysis metadata. Eligibility and each scenario context still apply. Transport choices keep their own evaluability gate.

ns0:rect.style: stroke: rgb(78%,85%,81%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(97%,93%,85%); fill-rule: evenodd;

ns0:g.ns0:text: Current driver AND both services privately eligible?
Driving is reported in usual modes or R-DRIVE-01. Both services also need
a household/future role and F-EVAL = Yes.

ns0:polygon.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(31%,41%,37%); fill-rule: evenodd;

ns0:rect.style: stroke: rgb(78%,85%,81%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(94%,95%,94%); fill-rule: evenodd;

ns0:g.ns0:text: Keep the ordinary eligible route
A non-driver can still compare an evaluable future
household service, or give a public/non-user view.

ns0:rect.style: stroke: rgb(78%,85%,81%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(91%,94%,97%); fill-rule: evenodd;

ns0:g.ns0:text: Primary service first; only its household acceptance module
The ordinary assignment selects the primary service. With dual eligibility, each service has a 0.5 probability of being first,
unless a recorded partner override sets the order.

ns0:g.ns0:text: Non-car respondents stay included
Transport when evaluable; a technology service
through a household/future role when evaluable;
public views otherwise.

ns0:g.ns0:text: Primary DCE context gate
Yes: one practice plus six choices. No/uncertain: skip
these choices, then continue to the other service.

A fresh concept, checks and scenario are provided.
Yes: one practice plus six choices. Otherwise skip
these choices.

ns0:g.ns0:text: Return to the primary service for reflections and benefits
Maximum review burden: 16 scored choices plus 3 practices. The ordinary cap remains 10 scored choices plus 2 practices.
